resources.string: HTTP streaming — open URL in browser or VLC
Broadcasts screen as MJPEG over local Wi-Fi. No accounts needed.
RTSP/RTP streaming — open in VLC, OBS, ffplay
Streams H.264/H.265 video over local network via RTSP.
WebRTC streaming — share link, view in browser
Streams to any browser via WebRTC. Works over internet.
